description: Read the running daemon's durable store identity (storeId) through the opt-in handshake. Save storeId durably with each import key BEFORE claudexor_upload_import, and replay that saved value unchanged; never replace it with a later answer. Resource ids and import keys belong to that store only.
name: claudexor_store_identity

engine.description: Build identity of the serving engine.

entry.description: Resolved entry path of the serving process.

sha.description: Git commit SHA of the build; 'unknown' outside a stamped package or git checkout.

servingMode.description: Product admission: 'recovery_only' keeps normal product routes closed while recovery control stays reachable; absent means 'normal'.

storeId.description: Immutable UUID of the durable engine store, stable across restarts; a run 404 is meaningful only with the same storeId. Returned only to a request sending `X-Claudexor-Store-Identity: 1` (older strict clients keep the legacy shape); absent when the store is unavailable or the daemon predates this field.
